title: Sofronio Vasquez lends his voice to ASEAN-themed song 'Seas Unbroken'
summary: Singer Sofronio Vasquez, the first Filipino and first male Asian winner of “The Voice” Season 26, has lent his vocals to “Seas Unbroken,” a new song celebrating unity among Southeast Asian nations.
